data.narrative:
Copenhagen Atomics is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $25M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 firms across the nuclear energy sector—3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Valar Atomics, Fuse Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, X-Energy, and Oklo.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $25M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $50M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $808M, reflecting the wide dispersion in nuclear energy valuations ($200M minimum to $6.0B maximum, with Fuse Energy at $200M Series A, Nano Nuclear at $808M Seed stage, and Valar Atomics at $6.0B Series B).

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $42M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $429M across the two methods. This wide band reflects material uncertainty regarding stage-appropriate valuation in an emerging, heterogeneous sector. The principal tension is between recent capital deployment ($25M) and peer multiples, which vary significantly by stage and technology maturity. Refinement would benefit from clarity on Copenhagen Atomics' specific technology differentiation and capital efficiency relative to the peer set.
